thread:
alex: just merged PR #4512 (small allocator tweak) — main CI turned red immediately. failing job: integration/gpu-smoke (stage: kv-cache-e2e). pipeline: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/1809991111 :grimacing:

ci-bot: build failed in job integration/gpu-smoke
```
FAIL: tests/integration/test_kv_cache_eviction.py::test_eviction_under_load
E       AssertionError: expected 4096 items, got 3932
...
Context: allocated=8192, evicted=2160, seed=374829
```

maria: @alex yikes. can you revert if it's obviously from your change? blocking downstream releases. :eyes:

alex: looking at the failure now. my change was supposed to be safe for small shards — but the seed in the log looks random. i will not revert immediately, want a quick rerun first.

liam: pinging @tom oncall — can you grab this? if rerun reproduces we should bisect or revert.

sre-bot: oncall assigned -> tom (pager duty). tagging responders and escalation rules.

tom: grabbing. starting with a rerun. @ci-bot please trigger rerun for run 1809991111 (job integration/gpu-smoke).

ci-bot: rerun triggered by tom: rerun_id=1809991111-2, queued on gpu-pool-3.

ci-bot: rerun complete (1809991111-2) — still failing in same test
```
FAIL: tests/integration/test_kv_cache_eviction.py::test_eviction_under_load
E       AssertionError: expected 4096 items, got 3928
Context: allocated=8192, evicted=2176, seed=374830
```

tom: same failure, different seed but same symptom. likely a regression in eviction thresholds. who owns allocator code? @alex logic touched allocator thresholds in PR #4512.

liam: can we bisect the merge window? alex, what's the merge range for last 6 commits?

alex: range: abc1234..def5678 (includes PRs 4509, 4510, 4512). my PR is def5678.

tom: starting git bisect on a local env now, will iterate through suspected commits and run the failing test. i'll post progress. if bisect implicates def5678 we should prepare an emergency revert PR.

maria: +1 on revert readiness. please drop a revert PR draft so we can merge quickly if needed.

tom: bisect update (~12m): reproduced locally; bisect narrowed to commit def5678 (author alex, PR #4512). repeating the failing test 10x: 10/10 failures under same config.

alex: if bisect points at mine i'll open a revert PR immediately and help investigate root cause in parallel. pulling the change now. :hammer_and_wrench:

liam: thanks tom. please post the minimal repro and any local command you ran so we can reproduce CI failure.

tom: repro command I used:
```
pytest tests/integration/test_kv_cache_eviction.py::test_eviction_under_load -k "eviction" -q --runslow --seed=374829
```
Local run shows same assertion.

tom: opening revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/revert-4512 (WIP). will mark as emergency and request fast-track.

alex: revert PR opened and request submitted. once CI for revert is green i'll merge to unblock main. also starting a debug branch to trace eviction counters.

maria: thanks all — please keep incident updates here. if revert merges, remember to follow up with a postmortem linking the failing test and what we learned.

liam: flag to incidents channel if revert fails or more fallout. otherwise fine to continue here.

tom: final note: bisect + local runs point at PR #4512. reverting to unblock main; root cause investigation continues. will post follow-up when I have more logs. :white_check_mark:
